rationale:
bugs_open/236 (522 half — refer by slug, the number is ambiguous): a fully built site, lendzy.co.uk, served HTTP 522 to every visitor indefinitely while every internal signal read green (sites.status='deployed', work items complete, pages deployed, the B2 sync workflow success, the commits present). Cause: the zone had no worker route at all, so Cloudflare proxied straight through to a placeholder origin that accepts no connections. The filer fixed lendzy by hand; the gap that let it happen is untouched. This is CLAUDE.md's own 'trust the rendered artefact, not the status' rule with the last link missing — we verify the artefact in the bucket and in git, never that the public URL returns it.

THE ABSENCE, RE-VERIFIED LIVE TODAY RATHER THAN CITED (2026-08-10, this session). scheduled_tasks: no availability/uptime/serve-shaped row; the only outbound health probe is ai-endpoint-health-check, which pings AI endpoints (Ollama /api/tags), not sites. discovery_checks/: check_backend_unreachable.go probes /health but returns early unless deploy_config.target='vm', so the static/worker-routed class — where lendzy died — is covered by nothing; check_asset_reference_404.go probes only subresources of an already-fetched page. site_work_items: zero open availability-shaped items. site_work_items needs_diagnosis: zero awaiting_diagnosis.

WHY THIS SHAPE. The discovery-check seam already owns filing, per-site dedup (idx_swi_dedup), retraction (CheckResult.Resolved, RFC_010) and two build-enforced coverage guards. A bespoke checker would re-implement all four and drift — which is the class this council exists to catch. Notably CheckResult.Resolved's own doc comment names this exact case as its example: 'a health probe that succeeded, so every open unreachable item for that site is answered at once'. The driver reuses the bugs_open/230 lane's site_discovery_rotation table and pre_query verbatim, changing only agent_type and the cooldown (7 days -> 4 hours, because an outage is not a content defect).

MEASURED BEFORE DESIGNING, NOT ASSERTED. All 21 deployed sites probed from this workstation: 21/21 return 200 + HTML. So this ships as a REGRESSION GUARD with no live positive, and '0 findings' will be exactly what a silently broken check also reports (016b s9). Two sites fail a stored-title assert and NEITHER files: webdesign.uk (deliberate 302 to webdesign.co.uk — the final-host rule) and mortgagecalculator.co.uk (serves 'The UK's Authority on Mortgage Finance' where the DB holds 'Free Tools & Insider Guides' — a divergent render, a different defect with its own machinery). Filing on title mismatch would have been 1/21 false-positive on day one, so it is a named finding, not an item. Stated limitation, not discovered later: a registrar-parked domain answering 200 lands in that same finding and files nothing.

EVERY GUARD IS PROVEN LOAD-BEARING BY MUTATION, each caught by a NAMED failing test (8 mutations, table in the test file header). Built and tested against a `git archive HEAD` tree because the working tree does not compile (another lane's WIP: datahelpers/page_canonical.go:185 undefined nestedOrFlatURL).

ORDERING, AND WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED. run_discovery_checks HARD-FAILS on a check name the binary does not register (bugs_open/149 B4), so the config half must not precede the image. The migration therefore ships as 372_site_availability_driver_HOLD.sql — the _HOLD suffix is the mechanism (SIDECAR_RE excludes it while still listing it); a banner cannot hold a file. Per the owner ruling of 2026-07-29 I claim NO ordering constraint for the code half: HEAD is shared, the check is inert until a config names it, and another session's roll shipping it early is harmless.

CONSUMERS TOLD, NOT MERELY MEASURED (2026-07-29 ruling s3). site_discovery_rotation gains rows with a fourth agent_type; the 230 lane's staleness watchdog keys on the three content agents and is unaffected — whether they extend it is their call, and a contribution note goes into their NOTES. site_work_items gains one item_type with a single producer and a stated key shape (2026-08-02 ruling s1: named producer set + key shape, so no RFC).

plan.summary: Add a site_unreachable discovery check that probes the public apex per site and files/self-clears one alert-only work item, plus a held migration seeding a lightweight availability agent and a 4-hourly fair rotation.

edits.rationale: The check itself. Gates on sites.status IN ('active','deployed') FIRST — a pool site's domain is unrouted BY DESIGN (the 071 lane's fixtures rely on that), so probing one would fabricate an outage. Loads the shipped index title through datahelpers.PageHasShippedPredicateFor rather than a hand-typed build_status='deployed' (bugs_open/185: pages.status is active/archived and cannot answer 'is this live'; needs_rebuild pages are still serving, and the commit-time pattern check flags the hand-typed form). Probes, and on an unreachable verdict RE-PROBES after a wait before filing — one blip must not raise a site-wide high-severity alarm. Files with HandlerAgent:'' because nothing in the estate can create a Cloudflare route today, so an alert that pretends to be actionable would be a lie the queue then carries; when a route-repairing agent exists it becomes the handler. On any serving verdict it retracts through CheckResult.Resolved with AllOfType:true and states the breadth at the call site, which is precisely the case that field's contract names.

The verdict table, kept PURE so every row is a table test rather than a network fixture. Unreachable = transport error, or a final status outside 2xx (the motivating 522, and 4xx/5xx at an apex are equally 'nobody can load the site'), or a 2xx whose body is empty or carries no <html. Deliberately NOT unreachable: an off-domain final host (a deliberate delegation still serves the visitor, and the delegate has its own row and its own probe), and an on-host 2xx whose body lacks the stored index title. That second demotion is the one I expect objections to, so the measurement is stated rather than the intuition: filing on it today would fire on 1 of 21 live sites, all of which serve correctly. The reason string is machine-readable (delegated / title_absent / http_522 / ...) so tightening the policy later is a one-line change with a name to search for.

A package-level var, not an inline client, so the whole check is testable without a network — the same seam probeAssetURL uses in check_asset_reference_404.go and for the same reason. GET rather than HEAD (a static origin need not implement HEAD, and its 405 would be indistinguishable from a policy refusal — the lesson already recorded on the 404 check). Redirects followed and the FINAL host returned, because the delegation rule needs it. Body capped so a pathological origin cannot make a discovery pass buffer without limit. An honest, identifiable User-Agent: if an origin refuses it, that is a status and the check reports what it saw rather than guessing. Outbound HTTP on the DISCOVERY path is established practice here (backend_unreachable, backend_entry_orphaned, tool_acceptance, asset_reference_404 all probe live); the standing objection recorded in verifier_coverage_test.go is to probes on the COMPLETION path, which this is not.

Twelve rows covering every verdict branch including www-vs-apex and an HTML-entity-escaped title, plus eight Run-level tests. The file header carries the mutation table: each of the eight guards was broken in a scratch copy and the NAMED test that failed is recorded beside it (drop the confirming re-probe -> BlipOnFirstProbeFilesNothing; treat delegation as unreachable -> DeliberateDelegationFilesNothing; file on title mismatch -> TitleAbsentIsAFindingNotAnItem; remove the pool gate -> PoolSiteIsNeverProbed; add a handler -> NeverRoutesToAHandler; retract while unreachable -> ConfirmedOutageFilesExactlyOneAlertItem; narrow the retraction -> HealthyRetractsAllOfType; widen 2xx to accept 5xx -> CloudflareFiveTwoTwoFiles). A guard no test can be made to fail against is decoration, and this check has no live positive to lean on.

The package's build-enforced sensor refuses a new ItemType literal until it is classified, so this is the gate working and the classification is made at birth rather than inferred later: catMechanical, no verifier, because the check SELF-CLEARS on a serving probe every rotation pass and a completion verifier would re-run the identical probe. DISCLOSED SAME-FILE PASSENGER, because no pathspec can exclude it: the same map also gains decision_regression, which is NOT this lane's — check_decision_guards shipped 2026-08-08 (e1628f7df) without a classification and has left this test RED at HEAD for two days, so the package could not run at all. Classified in passing and labelled as another lane's; whether decision_regression deserves a real verifier stays with RFC_015's owner.

edits.rationale: The driver, HELD by filename until a pod-grep proves the check string is in the running binary. A three-step agent (ensure_site_record -> run_discovery_checks[site_unreachable] -> complete) with no LLM steps and no spawns, so it adds no per-job Kafka topics while bugs_open/240 is live. The scheduled task is the 230 lane's pre_query verbatim with agent_type swapped and the cooldown cut to 4 hours; it takes its OWN concurrency_group so the scheduler's in-memory head-of-queue coupling (bugs_open/048) cannot make availability probes and content rotations block one another. Cadence arithmetic stated rather than felt: 21 eligible sites / 4h = 5.25 dispatches per hour needed against a 300s tick's 12 per hour, i.e. 2.3x headroom, dropping worst-case detection of a total outage from unbounded to about 4-8 hours. The verify block is DO/RAISE, not SELECTs — ON_ERROR_STOP ignores a non-empty result set, so only an exception can stop the COMMIT. A ROLLBACK file ships beside it and deliberately does NOT delete open site_unreachable items: if any exist, a real outage was detected and deleting the evidence is not a rollback.

Register entry in the same commit that ships the seam, per the 2026-07-28/29 rulings. It names the producer set and the item_key shape (the 2026-08-02 s1 condition), states the two deliberate non-filings and the parked-domain consequence as LANDMINEs, and records that the check finds nothing today so a future reader cannot mistake a clean sweep for a working checker. The index row for IMP-053 is already at HEAD — it was carried there as a same-file passenger by another lane's commit 01d64d564, which that lane has recorded in WRONG_CALLS.md; only the entry itself and a migration renumber remain in this commit.

plan.risks: NO LIVE POSITIVE. 21/21 sites serve today, so the check will report 0 findings and that is indistinguishable from a blinded check (016b s9). Mitigated by the mutation table, and the PLAN's verification protocol commits to the bug file's own break-it-on-purpose drill (delete a sacrificial worker route, watch the item file, restore, watch it self-clear) before any clean sweep is quoted as evidence. A registrar-parked domain answering 200 with an <html body files NOTHING — it lands in the title_absent finding. This is a stated limitation of v1, chosen because the alternative was a detector that fires on a healthy live site on day one. Zero parked domains in the fleet as measured today. ALERT-ONLY: with HandlerAgent:'' the item sits at 'detected' and nothing drains it (bugs_open/083's promoter question, 033's review surface — both open, neither this lane's). Same accepted trade as backend_unreachable. The self-clear means a hand-fixed outage closes its own item, so the queue does not accumulate stale alerts. OUTBOUND HTTP FROM THE DISCOVERY PATH, ~21 requests per 4 hours plus one re-probe per failure. Precedent is established (four checks already probe), but the assumption that the chassis pod's egress sees the same public serving path as a workstation is marked [ASSUMED] in the lane NOTES and is settled by the first live run, not by argument. SHARED TABLE: site_discovery_rotation gains a fourth agent_type. No schema change and the 230 lane's watchdog keys on the three content agents, so nothing of theirs breaks — but they are consumers and are being told directly rather than merely measured. ORDERING: applying the migration before the image rolls makes every availability run fail loudly (unregistered check name). Held by filename rather than by a banner, and the RUNBOOK's pod-grep is the gate. The reverse order is inert and harmless.
